newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius rupee firms on dollar and pound.

text.p: The Mauritian rupee firmed against both the dollar and the pound on Friday, in line with international trends, forex dealers said.
Banks posted the rupee at a mean commercial rate of 20.682 against the dollar on Friday from 20.697 on Thursday.
Against the pound, the rupee traded at a mean rate of 32.3790 compared with 32.4185 on Thursday.

Foreign exchange dealers said the rupee continued to be under weakening pressure on Friday as commercial banks were short in foreign currencies but this was offset by a softer dollar in overseas international markets.

"In view of the rupee going down, more and more banks' customers are hedging against future currency fluctuations and they are already buying dollars for future payments. This has resulted in banks reserves getting short rapidly," a dealer said.
The dealer said the shortage was not eradicated by a central bank intervention on Thursday mid afternoon.
The central bank intervened by selling dollars in the interbank forex market on Thursday at the prevailing interbank rate, dealers said.
